controls.title: SSH root login is disabled
controls.desc: Root must not log in over SSH.

descriptions.label: default
descriptions.data: Root must not log in over SSH.

controls.code:
control 'ssh-01' do
  impact 0.7
  title 'SSH root login is disabled'
  desc 'Root must not log in over SSH.'
  tag cis: '5.2.10'
  tag nist: ['AC-6']
  describe file('/etc/ssh/sshd_config') do
    its('content') { should match(/^PermitRootLogin no/) }
  end
end

results.code_desc: File /etc/ssh/sshd_config content is expected to match /^PermitRootLogin no/

controls.title: /etc/shadow is not world readable
controls.code:
control 'passwd-01' do
  impact 1.0
  title '/etc/shadow is not world readable'
  describe file('/etc/shadow') do
    it { should_not be_readable.by('others') }
  end
end

results.code_desc: File /etc/shadow is expected not to be readable by others

controls.title: /tmp is a separate partition
controls.code:
control 'tmp-01' do
  impact 0.5
  title '/tmp is a separate partition'
  describe mount('/tmp') do
    it { should be_mounted }
  end
end

results.code_desc: Mount /tmp is expected to be mounted

controls.title: telnet is not installed
controls.code:
control 'pkg-01' do
  impact 0.3
  title 'telnet is not installed'
  describe package('telnet') do
    it { should_not be_installed }
  end
end

results.code_desc: System Package telnet is expected not to be installed
